-- A quick tour of Nupp: gradual types over plain LuaJIT Lua.

local type Priority = "low" | "normal" | "high"

local function describe(name: string, priority: Priority): string
    return name .. " is " .. priority .. " priority"
end

local function filter<V>(xs: {V}, keep: function(V): boolean): {V}
    local out: {V} = {}
    for _, x in ipairs(xs) do
        if keep(x) then
            out[#out + 1] = x
        end
    end

    return out
end

local names = {"wash the car", "pay rent", "read a book"}
local long = filter(names, function(n)
    return #n > 10
end)

print(describe("pay rent", "high"))
for _, n in ipairs(long) do
    print(n)
end
